sections.title: Studio Progress
sections.executive_summary: Chewable Studios is actively developing multiple educational game prototypes with core technology systems established. The focus on genuinely fun gameplay combined with effective learning outcomes positions the studio to revive the golden age of educational gaming with modern technology.

sections.title: Development Status
highlights: Multiple game prototypes in active development
Community building with educators and parents

sections.title: Vision & Goals
sections.summary: Creating games that children genuinely choose to play, making learning enjoyable through entertainment-first design. Targeting platform expansion to mobile/tablet, curriculum integration partnerships with schools, and global reach through localization.

activity.author: Game Designer
activity.comment: The Unity-based pipeline is working great. We can prototype new game mechanics in days and iterate based on playtest feedback.

activity.author: Zachariah Ayers
activity.comment: Chewable Studios is officially open for business. Full-service game development and publishing across PC, console, and mobile platforms.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Founded educational game development studio creating interactive learning experiences for children in the spirit of Math Blaster and Zoombinis
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Modern educational games feel like dressed-up worksheets and have lost the magic that made classics like Math Blaster genuinely fun while teaching
businessValue: Making learning genuinely enjoyable for children
Adaptive AI-driven difficulty keeping players engaged
